conclusions: D000 launches 0x69b14 once from room initialization; 0x6a49c is a child dispatch target, not the persistent owner.

The owner polls operation 0x0116 selector -1, compares its exact result against authored event codes, performs branch-specific prelude and cleanup, services controller status, waits one native tick, and loops.
The telephone-book controller is dispatched only for TBK1 after two exact free-conversation queries and is wrapped by primary-runtime state transitions zero and one.
Operation 0x0139 modes zero and sixteen plus operation 0x0116 selector -1 remain explicit execution boundaries; this evidence does not assign guessed behavior to them.
evidenceBoundary: Dispatch ownership, call sites, constants, targets, status branches, countdown, and loop edge are recovered directly from the native control-flow IR and verified SH-4 bytes.
The internal arbitration semantics of operation 0x0116 selector -1 are not inferred from the event-code comparisons.
The gameplay effects of operation 0x0139 modes zero and sixteen remain unresolved.
